subject: Quick 20-minute exploratory sync — timezone check for Oliver Nguyen
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen+applicant@gmail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick 20-minute exploratory sync — timezone check for Oliver Nguyen

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for applying to the Senior Inference Engineer role. I’m Grace on the recruiting team at Redwood — we’d love to do a quick 20-minute exploratory call to learn a bit about your background and share the role details. Marcus (hiring manager) is looped for visibility.

I wanted to propose a few short windows — I’ve put each time in your local Lisbon time (WEST, UTC+1) and in Redwood PST (UTC-7) so it’s easy to pick: 

- Tue Jul 18: 14:00–14:20 WEST (06:00–06:20 PDT)
- Wed Jul 19: 09:30–09:50 WEST (01:30–01:50 PDT)
- Thu Jul 20: 11:00–11:20 WEST (03:00–03:20 PDT)

If none of those work, tell me two 30-minute blocks that do and I’ll try to match. If it’s easier, share your calendar link and I’ll send an invite. We’ll do a short technical fit + culture fit chat; you can expect Marcus or another engineer to join depending on slot.

Attaching a one-page role spec and a placeholder calendar invite I can send once we lock a time.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- role-spec-senior-sw.pdf (application/pdf) — 1 page summary
- redwood-intro.ics (text/calendar) — tentative 20-min slot template
From: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen+applicant@gmail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T17:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Quick 20-minute exploratory sync — timezone check for Oliver Nguyen

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the note and the role spec — appreciate the timezone breakdown. I’m in Lisbon so the WEST times are perfect to see. A few notes: I’m traveling on the morning of Jul 18 but free in the afternoon; Jul 19 early morning is tight for me (doctor appointment). 

My preferences, in order: 
1) Thu Jul 20 at 11:00 WEST (works best)
2) Tue Jul 18 at 14:00 WEST (if Thu fills)

Phone is +351 91 234 5678 — I’m happy to take either a Zoom or phone call. If you need a slightly longer slot I can carve 30 minutes on my calendar, but 20 is fine for intro.

Thanks, looking forward to it.

—Oliver

Subject: Confirming Thu Jul 20 — 11:00 WEST / Zoom link + prep

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Oliver. 

I’ve locked Thu Jul 20 at 11:00 WEST (03:00 PDT) for a 20-minute intro. Invite attached (redwood-intro.ics). Please accept when you see it; Zoom link is in the invite but I’ve pasted it here in case calendar systems strip attachments: 
https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=example

Quick prep so we make the most of 20 minutes: 
- Expect ~10 minutes on your background (projects, systems you built, inference scaling experience)
- ~8 minutes on the role and team; Marcus may ask about prior infra choices and GPU/serving tradeoffs
- Any questions for us at the end — compensation/remote/hiring timeline are fair game

If anything changes, ping me on email or +1 (415) 555-0123. Looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Grace

See you Thu Jul 20.
